approval.note: Proposed criteria, not approved criteria (v8.0 section 27).

rule: A track is ready only if every critical gate in it is PASS with every evidence path present and matching its recorded sha256. Any other status, or missing evidence, fails readiness.

gates.name: DEMO_SCOPE
gates.criterion: Named Engine version, workflow, mode, permissible source and disclosure boundary.

gates.name: CAPABILITIES
gates.criterion: Every capability TESTED, UNTESTED or KNOWN_FAILURE with evidence, corpus and mode.

gates.name: FROZEN_DEMO
gates.criterion: Manifest frozen before rehearsal; unchanged recorded outcomes; includes an uncertainty or failure case.

gates.name: LIMITATIONS_AND_INTEGRITY
gates.criterion: Limitations shown in the demo; no inflated claim; replay or live labelled; artifact checks pass.

gates.name: DEMO_DECISION
gates.criterion: Actual dated approval by Phillip of the defined demonstration package.

gates.name: OFFER_SCOPE
gates.criterion: Workflow, route, approved price status, users, duration, limits, exclusions, HR-scope issue disposed.

gates.name: COMMERCIAL_AUTHORITY
gates.criterion: Exact evaluation grant and assets have the required evidence and actual authority.

gates.name: EXECUTABLE_DELIVERY
gates.criterion: Declared route; clean install, configuration, export and failure tests pass on the delivered artifact.

gates.name: LIVE_SMOKE
gates.criterion: Bounded provider execution ran; all attempts preserved; contract, version and cost controls pass.

gates.name: DATA_SPEND_AND_INJECTION
gates.criterion: Customer-run disclosures and checklist; implemented controls; adversarial requirements; support data boundary.

gates.name: EVIDENCE_AND_CLAIMS
gates.criterion: Reproducible paired metrics or truthful NOT ASSESSED; reference limits explicit; no unsupported claim.

gates.name: COMMERCIAL_OPERATIONS
gates.criterion: Approved price and support, agreement disposition, invoice, activation, remedy, closeout, procurement disposition.

gates.name: AUDIT_AND_RELEASE
gates.criterion: Versioned archives and hashes, redacted audit evidence, encumbrance register, actual release decision, no unresolved material defect.

track_c: Prepared only on a named counterparty trigger (decision sheet E-08). Not defined here.
